title: Canonical derived single-module comparison on a pullback square
statement: Let $Y,B,A$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $p:Y\to B$, $g:A\to B$, and $M$ an $\mathcal O_Y$-module. Put $q:Y\times_B A\to Y$ and $r:Y\times_B A\to A$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Define $c_q:Lq^*(M[0])\to(q^*M)[0]$ by the universal left-derived pullback counit [def-pc-derived-pullback], followed by localization of the termwise single-complex identification [def-pc-module-pullback, def-pc-derived-category]. Define $\beta_{p,M,g}:Lg^*Rp_*(M[0])\to Rr_*((q^*M)[0])$ as the canonical derived base-change mate [def-pc-derived-base-change-map] followed by $Rr_*(c_q)$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. No flatness, quasi-coherence, or invertibility is required or asserted.

proof.text: Use the existing pinned termwise single pullback map, which is the universal counit followed by the canonical single-complex identification and the unique tensor-pullback comparison.
Compose the canonical derived base-change mate with direct image of that map along the pullback projection.

lean.statement:
def standardSingleBaseChangeMap
    {Y B A : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ B) (M : Y.Modules) (g : A ⟶ B) :
    letI := fun X : Scheme.{u} ↦ HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    (derivedPullback g).obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage p).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj M)) ⟶
    (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd p g)).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (pullback p g).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj (pullback.fst p g) M))
